description: One step of an agent-to-agent handoff chain: who handed the work to whom, when, what it said about it, what travelled and what was lost, and how far the receiving agent got. The record is a VALUE: a host recomposes it with step with { … } when the receiving agent accepts or finishes the work, and no component mutates it. Both agent identities are the shared AgentRef, so a step paints the same initials, name and palette slot every other agent surface uses; a host that tracks agents by id only supplies FromAgentId / ToAgentId and the surface prints the id. The step deliberately does not decide what "lost" costs: the two item lists are the host's truth and LostCount / LossRate are the arithmetic a surface and a caller share, so a summary can never disagree with the lists it summarises.

members.name: At
members.description: When the handoff happened, or null while it is still pending.

members.name: FromAgent
members.description: The agent that handed the work over, or null when the host tracks agents by id only. Setting it makes the surface paint the agent's initials, name and palette slot.

members.name: FromAgentId
members.description: The handing-over agent's id as a plain string, for a host whose agents are not AgentRefs. FromAgent wins when both are set, because it carries the whole identity.

members.name: FromColorToken
members.description: The agent palette token the handing-over agent's avatar paints with, or an empty string when no FromAgent is set. Always a declared --tm-agent-color-{0..7} token when it is not empty.

members.name: FromName
members.description: The handing-over agent's name for a surface to print: the agent's name, else the raw id.

members.name: HasFrom
members.description: Whether the host named the handing-over agent in any way.

members.name: HasKnownStatus
members.description: Whether Status is one of the declared states (a cast integer may not be).

members.name: HasLosses
members.description: Whether anything was lost in this step — the fact the surface paints first.

members.name: HasSummary
members.description: Whether the host supplied a summary worth printing.

members.name: HasTo
members.description: Whether the host named the receiving agent in any way.

members.name: Id
members.description: Stable identity of the step. Never empty: a missing id is generated at construction.

members.name: IsPending
members.description: Whether the handoff is still waiting for the receiving agent.

members.name: IsRejected
members.description: Whether the receiving agent refused the work.

members.name: IsSettled
members.description: Whether the handoff was answered (accepted or completed).

members.name: ItemCount
members.description: How many items the step tried to hand over (passed plus lost).

members.name: LossRate
members.description: How much of what the step carried was lost, from 0 to 1, or 0 when it carried nothing (there is no loss rate without a whole).

members.name: LostCount
members.description: How many items never arrived.

members.name: PassedCount
members.description: How many items reached the next agent.

members.name: Status
members.description: How far the handoff has got. Default Pending; painted as an icon, a localized word AND a tone, never as a colour alone.

members.name: Summary
members.description: What the handing-over agent said about the work. Empty renders the surface's own fallback.

members.name: ToAgent
members.description: The agent that received the work, or null when the host tracks agents by id only.

members.name: ToAgentId
members.description: The receiving agent's id as a plain string. ToAgent wins when both are set.

members.name: ToColorToken
members.description: The receiving agent's palette token, or an empty string when no ToAgent is set.

members.name: ToName
members.description: The receiving agent's name for a surface to print: the agent's name, else the raw id.
